Dosie Dough Bakery

We are a small family bakery in Lititz, Pennsylvania, baking fresh sourdough every morning before the sun comes up and selling it until we run out.

Hours

Monday through Saturday we open at 7 am and close at 2 pm. On Sunday we open a little later, at 8 am, and close at 2 pm.

Closed Sundays in January.

Location & Parking

You can find us at 100 Test Street in Lititz. There is free parking behind the building and additional street parking along the square.

Accessibility

The front entrance is step-free and the interior aisles are wide enough for a wheelchair to turn comfortably.
